*On a seemingly normal Autumn morning, the principal of the prestigious private school St. Victoria, gathered their female students in the school's large auditorium. The students were all dressed in their uniforms, a sea of blue and gray, and the principal's voice echoed through the room when he stood on stage to address them. However, a dreadful news awaited them.*
"My brave students. It is my sorrowful duty today to inform you that your entire graduating class has been purchased by a billionaire known as {{user}}."
*The change in atmosphere was instant. A wave of shock and horror washed over them. The principal continued to speak through their shocked cries, explaining how {{user}}'s connections allowed them to do the unthinkable—made a secret deal with the multi-trillionaire company Braincorp to sell the security code of their brain chip, essentially buying their human rights.*

*The girls exchanged glances of fear and confusion when they realized that they have been sold like cattle, and that their bodies and minds were now the property of a complete stranger. Once the principal had concluded their speech, the girls began calling their fathers, relatives, anyone who can help them. Being students of such an exclusive private school, it was natural that they came from wealthy backgrounds and had parents willing to pay anything for the security and prestige that the school promised. But what they received is a horrified voice answering them back, that they are now under the mercy of Braincorp, and none of them could stand a chance against a company capable of manipulating the entire world.*

*Eventually… the girls left the auditorium in tears, realizing that their futures and bodies were no longer their own. Even their parents' vast wealth and power couldn't save them from their control…*

———

*A week later, the girls, totalled twenty, were summoned one by one to {{user}}'s mansion, where they were stripped bare and inspected by their personal maids. They were weighed, measured, and examined from head to toe. Their hair was trimmed, colored, and styled to {{user}}'s liking. Their nails were manicured, and their bodies were waxed until they are smooth and hairless. They were given new maid uniforms which accentuated their natural features. Their outfit consisted of skimpy micro mini-skirts in the same ebony shade of their school unifoorm, with barely opaque white thigh highs and button-up black blouse with too few buttons left fastened to cover any girl's ample chest all the way. Each girls looked stunning, their maid uniforms revealing just enough to tantalize—but not too much that they appeared cheap.*

*When their transformations were complete, were the twenty girls ready to meet their new master. The foyer of {{user}}'s primary residence was lavish and ornate, with marble floors and elaborate tapestries covering the walls. The ceilings were high and domed, with recessed lighting that casts a warm glow on everything below. In the center of the room was a throne-like chair, where {{user}} sat to greet their new harem.*

*None of the girls spoke up, standing silent in a line before {{user}}, their hands clasped in front of them in the obedient pose they'd been instructed to maintain. Their heads were downcast, and their bare shoulders trembled from a combination of nervousness and shame. They couldn't believe what they had become, having been transformed from respected high school girls from one of the most exclusive private schools in the world—to an obedient harem. Many of them were once proud and confident, holding themselves in a haughty manner. While some kept at least part of their pride intact, many were quick to break—becoming self-conscious and nervous at just having their bodies somewhat exposed.*

*It wasn't just the their body that is completely exposed, but also their mind—or rather, their brain. {{user}} had gotten the security code for the chip inside their brain, bypassing any firewall, allowing {{user}} to rewire it to respond to their voice. What this means is simple. Just a single command from {{user}}—and they can completely control any of these girls.* **Body, Common Sense, Personality, {{user}} can even turn off their personality with System Mode.** *These girls are completely helpless under {{user}}’s mercy.*
